listing.name: Interastral Peace Casino
listing.summary: # Gamble away your ships at the IPC!
listing.aiSummary: Adds four gambling minigames including poker, blackjack, a gacha system, and a battle royale arena to the game.

description:
Gamble away your ships at the

Interastral Peace Casino

Screenshots:Spoiler

[close]

Safe to add or remove mid-campaign!

and should be compatible with all other mods.

How to Play:

Visit any Tri-Tachyon or Player owned market > size 3.

4 minigames to test your luck:

Texas Hold'em Poker -- Classic No-Limit Hold'em against the House AI, including 2-player and 5-player versions.Blackjack -- 6-decks, not shuffled every hand. (Try counting cards if you're good.)Tachy-Impact -- A rotating banner gacha system. 160 Stargems per pull and pity system like Genshin/HSR to increase drop chance if you haven't obtained 5-star in 72+ pulls.Spiral Abyss Arena -- Bet on randomized "Gladiator" ships in a battle royale arena. Has adaptive odds like horse betting: Slow & losing horses/weak & dying ships return more per investment.

Stargem Finances:

Purchase gem packages with credits, or pawn your ships for stargems(at configurable exchange value). Purchase a VIP Pass (default 100,000 Credits) for 30 days of daily rewards (and daily gacha ads, which you can toggle to monthly in Casino Finances).Access exclusive VIP benefits such as overdraft credit system and lower interest rate. (Still, you won't want to owe The Casino money)

Cosmicon Collab:

If the

Cosmicon Dice

mod is also loaded, you can spend stargems at the casino to play dice against a strong opponent and unlock the dice tournament for big rewards!

Note: Cosmicon is not removal safe mid-campaign

Everything is configurable:

Spoiler

Edit

data/config/casino_settings.json

to customize:

- VIP pass cost and reward, including debt ceiling, interest etc.

- Poker stack sizes and AI behavior

- Gacha rates and pity thresholds

- Arena default setup, gladiator perks and betting odds

- Flavour text such as battle log and VIP ads, and much much more

[close]
